Good Day Good Dog: Raisin!
By Kristin Carol,
13 hours agoLUBBOCK, Texas (KJTV) - From LAS:. Raisin was an owner surrender due to no fault of her own. The family that adopted her was not ready to take on that role. Raisin is a 7-month-old, sweet girl who wants nothing more than to be loved on. She can be shy around new people but she warms up quickly once she knows she can trust you. She is a champion when it comes to taking naps, snuggles and kisses. She is still learning her basic commands, but is house and kennel trained. She loves treats of all kinds, especially pup-cups, walks and just being outside. She is up-to-date on shots, microchipped, spayed and she is ready to go home.
